title: Geometric construction of optimal probe states in distributed multiparameter quantum sensing
summary: The choice of probe state is essential to achieving ultimate precision in quantum metrology. For a single parameter, an equal superposition of eigenstates associated with the largest and smallest generator eigenvalues is optimal. This simple construction does not directly extend to multiple parameters, since different parameters can favor different probes. We address this difficulty through a geometric construction of optimal probes for multiparameter estimation in distributed quantum sensing.
